prompt: Which draws a red-to-blue horizontal gradient across a 200x100 rectangle?
choices: Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D) g; g2d.setGradient(Color.RED, Color.BLUE); g2d.fillRect(0,0,200,100);
explanation: GradientPaint(x1,y1,startColor, x2,y2,endColor) defines a linear gradient from left to right. setPaint sets it as the current paint; fillRect uses it. Options C and D use methods that don't exist in the Graphics/Graphics2D API.
